about: The collecta of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: God, You who illuminate this most sacred night with the glory of the Lord’s Resurrection, preserve in the new offspring of Your family the spirit of adoption that You have given, so that, renewed in body and mind, they may offer You pure service. Through the same Jesus Christ, our Lord, Your Son, who, as God, lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit forever and ever.

alignments.gloss: illuminate this most sacred night with the glory of the Lord’s Resurrection
the new offspring of Your family
they may render pure service to You
the same Jesus Christ, our Lord
who lives and reigns with You
in the unity of the Holy Spirit

w002.explanation: The prayer addresses God directly as the One who illuminates this night.

w015.explanation: Nova describes the new offspring. Familiae tuae means “of Your family”.

w017.explanation: Adoptionis describes the spirit as the spirit of adoption.

w027.explanation: Exhibeant refers to the new offspring, who are to offer pure service to God.

w039.explanation: Vivit et regnat means “lives and reigns”. Tecum means “with You”.

w046.explanation: Deus names Jesus Christ as God.
